strings.gwipeConfirm:
⚠️ Full Google wipe:

• Clears Play Store + Google Play services + Services Framework data.
• ⛔ You WILL be signed out of Google accounts (you must re-add them).
• Your photos and apps are untouched.
• The device reboots automatically after.

Are you sure?

strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: mriksa kothak tombol saiki marang Google's dhaptar panjabutan (CRL) lan nyoba macem-macem sumber nganti nemokake kothak tombol bener, karo serep otomatis lan miwiti maneh layanan Google. Mlaku ing saben tutul lan mbutuhake internet (1-3 menit).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox from network: downloads a keybox from the official repository (GitHub) and saves it to /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Needs internet and takes 1-3 minutes. Used when the smart fetch fails or when the keybox was changed manually.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • diagnosis RKP: mriksa modul Remote Key Provisioning sing kasedhiya, mriksa versi sertifikat pengesahan TEE, lan nuduhake status alat KmInstallKeybox. Ora ana owah-owahan — tampilan status piranti kosong.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine check (read-only): shows Widevine level indicators (L1/L3) from dumpsys, DRM (IDM) key-file presence, and related system properties. Modifies nothing at all.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP fix: nganggo sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Ndandani masalah bukti nalika pass otomatis gagal. Saben roto nyetak garis sukses / gagal sing jelas.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh full. Handles the hard cases and takes longer. A clear result appears at the end.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Reset GMS: mbusak data Play Store lan Google (GMS+GSF) lan reboot piranti kanthi otomatis. Mung kanggo bukti wangkal — ora nate ndemek foto utawa file sampeyan.
strings.mdCertify: • Sertifikasi Play: mriksa status sertifikat RKP piranti lan ngreset sifat bukti yen perlu. Ora ndemek data pangguna.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER repair: fixes Google services framework (SOTER) issues related to device attestation. Used for some devices that rely on SOTER instead of Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Apply PIF: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh force. Applies the selected fingerprint (local/advanced) and updates the pif.prop/pif.json files. A clear result appears in the log.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF check: shows the installed engine state, the fingerprint files (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), and the logs. Check only — it modifies nothing.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Fetches the latest Canary Engine release to ensure compatibility with the mandatory RKP certificates (February 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine diagnosis: checks the TrickyStoreOSS state (pid, logs), the keybox files (active vs user), the real vs spoofed device fingerprint, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys. Diagnostic display only.
strings.hintKbSlots: Modul ngatur rong slot keybox: utami (suci, ora tau dibusak) lan sekunder (serep). Tab iki nuduhake kang slot aktif, ngalih pilihan, utawa dipun promosiaken secondary kanggo utami ing request eksplisit - karo serep lan log lengkap.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Integrity diagnosis: checks the TEE key import, the library injection inside keystore2, the revocation status (CRL), the protection-list coverage and the RKP state. Read-only — it changes nothing.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• The protection list is rebuilt from every installed app.
• The custom-ROM compatibility layer is re-applied.
• The active keybox is re-applied.
• Google Play services are restarted.

Nothing is deleted and the primary keybox is never touched.

Continue?
strings.mdKbSlots: • slot Keybox: nuduhake negara saka utami lan secondary slot lan ngalih pilihan antarane wong-wong mau. Utama (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) tansah dilindhungi lan ora bakal dibusak. Promosi sekunder menyang primer mbutuhake konfirmasi sing jelas.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Ningkatake slot sekunder menyang primer:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml dadi isi slot utama.
• Primer saiki disimpen minangka serep sadurunge diganti.
• Ora ana sing dibusak — operasi bisa dibalik.

Terus?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Busak slot sekunder:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml bakal dicopot.
• Slot utama ora didemek.

Terus?

strings.confirmKbSmart:
Smart keybox fetch (anyar ing v3.17):

• Priksa kothak tombol saiki karo Google dhaptar panjabutan (CRL).
• Nyoba macem-macem sumber nganti kothak tombol sing resik ditemokake.
• Gawe serep otomatis + diwiwiti maneh Google5##00009# layanan internet. (1-3 min). Terus?
strings.confirmKbNet:
Njupuk kothak tombol saka internet:

• Ngundhuh kothak tombol resmi lan validasi.
• Dipasang kanthi permanen (ora tau dibalèkaké nalika boot).

⚠️ Perlu internet (nganti 1 menit). Terus?
strings.confirmRkpManual:
Re-provision RKP keys:

• Ora ana data utawa file keybox sing dibusak.
• Urip maneh telpon sakwise.

Terus?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Diposaken lengkap:

• Re-pranata RKP + miwiti maneh Google layanan.
• Piranti urip maneh kanthi otomatis (ora ana sing dibusak).

Terus?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Wiwiti maneh layanan Google:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — mung miwiti maneh.
• Ora ana sing dibusak lan sampeyan ora bakal metu.
• Piranti urip maneh kanthi otomatis.

Terus?
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Meksa re-provision (Red Magic):

• Kanggo piranti sing ora nglirwakake kothak tombol sing bocor.
• Bisa uga sanajan tombol sehat.
• Ora ana data sing dibusak.

Terus?
strings.confirmCertify:
Meksa Play Store sertifikasi:

• Mbusak mung cache Toko — akun sampeyan ora kena.
• Urip maneh, banjur bukak Toko.

Terus?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER repair:

• Wiwiti maneh layanan vendor.soter.
• Mbusak data server mung SOTER.

Terus?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Aplikasi sidik jari (PIF):

• Ngonversi custom.pif.prop lan nginstal ing jalur mesin.
• Mbutuhake urip maneh sakwise.

Terus?
strings.confirmCanary:
Nganyari bekas driji Canary:

• Ngundhuh sidik jari Canary resmi paling anyar saka Google.
• Nyelarasake patch keamanan + miwiti layanan Google (ora ngilangke).

⚠️ Perlu internet (1-3 mnt). Terus?
